notes.title: Glitchy Frame Studio Supports the Stop Killing Games Initiative
notes.notes: [p]Many of you have probably already heard of the [b]Stop Killing Games[/b] European Citizens’ Initiative, which aims to ensure that digital games remain playable even after publishers or developers no longer support them.[/p][p]We believe that when someone buys a game, they do it because they love it – and they want to play it whenever they choose. As developers, we create games to bring joy to players.[/p][h3][b]Taking a working game away from its audience should never be part of a responsible gaming industry's future.[/b][/h3][p]That’s why, as the team behind Glitchy Frame Studio, we want to publicly express our support for the Stop Killing Games initiative.[/p]

notes.title: Dear city heroes, the long-awaited Anomaly mode has arrived!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear city heroes![/h2]

Targeted -10 Days was released two months ago, and we’ve been working on the most important update to date for you.

Since the game's first launch, you’ve seen a menu option, hinting that while the game was ready, we had something more in mind. This menu is called Anomaly mode, and we’ve spent the last two months since its release ensuring this distinct mode is now in your hands.

[previewyoutube=iNo8oT15o-E;full][/previewyoutube]

The Anomaly mode is now available for everyone. This is not a temporary mode or a brief detour; it is an integral part of the Targeted -10 Days experience, finally shaping the game the way we envisioned it from the start of development.

Anomaly mode, with its horror elements, now features supernatural traps, requiring a completely different mindset than the assassin-themed Targeted gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/ec0071550da582a46a200b12e2cccb8c2eac7a34.jpg[/img]

The sounds and environment have been reworked so that it takes a bit more courage to step out of the elevator, as darkness surrounds you, with only a small, shaky flashlight to light your way. The anomalies are more bizarre than ever, with unexpected changes on posters, things happening behind your back, and new terrifying characters you’ll get to know up close.

Anomaly mode starts from level T-25, which may make it quite challenging. However, with over 60 traps awaiting you in this mode alone, we believe that even after several playthrough attempts, you won't get bored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/463e48014c93827c58eef3a0132c4b5c3203adaa.jpg[/img]

The game still saves when you exit, and we track your time so you can appear on the leaderboard.

The playthrough offers a new, hand-animated ending, where you’ll finally meet Don K. himself!

[h2]We Outplayed the RNG Gods![/h2]

Many of you provided feedback, and we, of course, listened. One of the most frequent criticisms was that anomalies repeated too often.

Currently, there are so many anomalies in the game that we can't even count them ourselves; with different variations, there are about 170 in normal mode and over 60 in anomaly mode. Still, sometimes the Random Number Generator Gods decided to keep throwing the same anomalies at you.

We tried to outsmart the RNG gods, and programmer 4NDR34 (not András, not Andor, and not the programmer’s girlfriend) crafted the ultimate code to prevent the same anomaly from appearing consecutively. The issue was that the RNG gods weren’t appeased; they still made the traps repeat every two rounds, leading some to feel there were too many repeats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/6aae49b4bd617ac084baea519e2fd7d8382d28b6.jpg[/img]

4NDR34 (not the car parked in-game, but our programmer) finally put the RNG gods in their place, creating the perfect code that ensures no trap repeats during a playthrough. In short, from this update onward, repetitions will cease.

We hope you enjoy what is likely the last major update to the game. If you have any questions or encounter bugs, feel free to join us on Discord at [url=https://glitchyframestudio.eu/discord]https://glitchyframestudio.eu/discord[/url].

We wish you successful survival!

notes.title: The Infiltration Update Has Arrived
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear city heroes![/h2]

Targeted -10 Days has turned one month old, and we too have experienced a very interesting and exciting period.

We were eagerly waiting for you to finally get your hands on the game, and we are so grateful that you have welcomed Targeted so positively. The reviews, feedback, and streams have reassured us that we have succeeded in creating a fun, engaging game, and the fact that so many of you have invested so much time into such a small game is a particular joy and honor for us.

It was fun to see and read how some of you were competing with each other for better times, and we watched with great pleasure those who streamed their challenges.

Over the past month, we have tried to keep an eye on every streamer or content creator to better understand how you are playing the game. Some took it up once and struggled with the challenges, while others honed their senses to such an extent during gameplay that they were incapable of making mistakes. It was incredible to see that some were more skilled on their first playthrough than us, who set the traps ¯_(ツ)_/¯

The T-99 mode was added to the game as a kind of final boss, an enemy we knew very few would even attempt to defeat. However, we thought that if someone did try, thanks to the save system, there would be no need to rush; it could be a multi-day challenge.

To our great delight, several have managed to overcome this obstacle, defeating the game, thus earning the rarest achievements and watching the secret ending video.

The current list of T-99 heroes is as follows: Animetool, CeruzásFeri, I_Ritus_I, Panyi, Starlis, and TrickyM. The citizens of the city will never forget your names.

But let's get to the point, the first big update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/fdb89bb1abcdefb99c8cb51ec2fe641e890c5c78.png[/img]

[h2]THE INFILTRATION UPDATE[/h2]

The Infiltration Update goes live today, bringing with it over 25 new traps. The Don’s men are still trying, and their goal is to infiltrate the garage, pretending to be workers, seemingly performing tasks that the staff would normally handle, but in reality, planting a bomb somewhere in the garage.

So, expect clues that might point to a cleaner, a maintenance worker, a mechanic, or other roles. For instance, if you find a broom hidden behind the pipes, it wasn’t left there by the cleaning lady, but by one of Don’s men.

This update presents tougher challenges, requiring more attention than ever before. The earlier puzzles remain, so this update offers a greater challenge for veteran players, as their eyes aren’t yet trained on these new types of clues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/4e9679faf549138ef337e7d102e46d4aec79fb94.png[/img]

[h2]PREPARING FOR THE HORRORS, OR THE NEXT UPDATE[/h2]

In many parts of the world, autumn is the time when the realms of the living and the dead come closest together. In the world of Targeted, this phenomenon is particularly strong, especially when Don calls upon his supernatural powers to stop us. As a result, the long-planned Anomaly Mode will finally be available in the 2nd free update package.

Anomaly Mode will be a relatively easier version of the game, with fewer difficult puzzles to expect, but we will bring you many more spooky or even humorous solutions.

In Anomaly Mode, we will finally get to meet Don K., the one pulling the strings, in person!

We hope you will enjoy this mode too, and we believe it will be worth picking up the game again for those who have already played through Targeted.

Anomaly Mode is still under development, expected to have 25 levels and at least 40 anomalies, if not more. This is still in progress. If all goes well, Anomaly Mode will be available by mid-October.

Thank you for joining us over the past month. We’ll be back soon, and until then, we wish everyone successful survival.

notes.title: Our gangster had eye surgery
notes.notes:
The first update of Targeted has been completed since its release.
We have watched a lot of YouTubers playing our game in recent days, and thanks to them, we've seen the small details that needed to be adjusted.

Although the update process was a bit more complicated than before the release, everything seems to be fine, so let’s take a look at the few small changes that were made:

So the following things have changed for the better in the game:

[list]
[*] Tiny correction in the Hungarian language
[*] The location of the handprint at the elevator on the map has been modified
[*] The guy hiding in the trash can had eye surgery
[*] The guy in the "alley" has become a master of disguise
[/list]
Thank you so much for playing our game, we’re sending a big virtual high-five to each and every one of you who shows interest.

We’d like to leave a tip at the end of the first hotfix package, which will help you defeat the T-99 mode:
[b]The game has a save feature, you can exit at any time, and you will continue from the level you were on, nothing will be lost ːwinter2019happyyulː[/b]

notes.title: On August 14th, Targeted will be released
notes.notes:
The Don's crime syndicate did everything in its power to catch the traitor as soon as possible, but they were unsuccessful. Therefore, we are pleased to announce that our game may be released on the Steam platform on August 14th.

To ensure a smooth launch, we've prepared a tutorial video for you, where you can learn how our game works and what to watch out for.

[previewyoutube=vIpMDgNBpcM;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, we would like to draw your attention to our Targeted manual, which contains all the information you need to know about the game. The manual is available in [url=https://glitchyframestudio.eu/targeted/Targeted_Manual_HU.pdf]Hungarian[/url] and [url=https://glitchyframestudio.eu/targeted/Targeted_Manual_EN.pdf]English[/url] on the Steam Store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116546/353d95d29e795b220ba61dd8a1bd2fd0685b2341.png[/img]

We are excited to hear your thoughts on the game, and we hope you will enjoy it. As a teaser, we would like to recommend the test run by The VR Hungarian video team.

[previewyoutube=P_FHY1gDpTc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Deck Support Coming Soon for Targeted - 10 Days!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Targeted - 10 Days will soon support Steam Deck!

Starting with our upcoming release, you’ll be able to enjoy the challenges of our game on the Steam Deck, even while on the go.

We designed the game to run perfectly even on lower-end computers, and the Steam Deck itself is a powerhouse that can easily handle the world of Targeted.

We have only had the opportunity to test the Steam Deck version briefly, but it works well with both Proton (recommended) and the native Linux version.

The release date is not 100% set yet, but if all goes well, it should be available for purchase next week.

We'll be back soon, so take care in the meantime.

Best,
Glitchy Frame Studio Team

notes.title: We are pleased to announce our game, Targeted.
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome from the Targeted team![/h1]

[h3]We are thrilled and excited to inform you that Glitchy Frame Studio's first game, Targeted, will soon be released.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=b46hth3a2TY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Targeted is a new variation of the recently popular anomaly searching games and endless loop games.[/b]

in Targeted, as a former Mafia member, you are trying to testify against The Don, who will do everything in his power to eliminate you. To survive, you must search for signs of sabotage in the underground garage where your car is stored, to reveal if anyone has been there before you.

The gameplay is simple: if you see anything unusual, you must rush to the elevator and escape immediately. However, if everything seems fine, you can get into your car to get to the next session of the 10-day-long trial... alive.

But we must remain vigilant; if our decision proves to be wrong, the gangsters will strike, and we will have to start the game over.

[previewyoutube=j6lkk3FdmU4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]In Targeted, you are the target of the assassination, so be careful and thorough![/b]

If you have any questions, thoughts, or ideas, we would be happy to hear from you on [url=https://glitchyframestudio.eu/discord]Discord[/url] or here on the Steam forum.

[h3]If you enjoy the game, please don't forget to add Targeted to your wishlist :)[/h3]
